prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: six-frame videogame sprite animation for a classic Ragnarok Online custom Samurai.
Input image: immutable character design, pixel art style, proportions, face and SOUTHWEST, front three-quarter toward screen-left direction. Extend this exact Samurai character into a six-frame two-handed katana swing animation, BUT OMIT THE ENTIRE WEAPON so the body can be layered with a separate katana later. Show coherent empty closed grips as if grasping the same invisible hilt; two hands must stay close together along its axis. Never paint any blade, hilt, scabbard, trail, glow or attack effects.
Preserve the exact black high ponytail with red tie, large expressive head, indigo short kimono, muted red sash and rear panels, steel shoulder armor, black bracers, loose navy trousers, chunky brown boots, compact classic RO anatomy and clustered pixel shading. The illustration is approximately4× the native90px game sprite, with standing body height360–370pixels. Keep anatomy and scale identical between all frames; no pose-dependent rescaling.
Genuine transparent alpha background, no shadows, text, labels, scenery or grid. Canvas1536×1024, exactly3columns×2rows of512×512 equalcells. Whole figures centered at x256 in eachcell with stable planted-feet root at y420, ample transparent gutters and clearance for raised hands; no cutoffs. Pixel art at4×game scale, restrained palette, no anti-alias blur or whiteoutline.
All six frames face SOUTHWEST, front three-quarter toward screen-left exactly as reference; this is a chronological animation, not a rotation sheet. Torso may twist subtly with swing but must not change viewing direction. Keep both feet planted close to same root, rotate heels naturally instead of sliding across cells.
Frame1 top-left: preparation guard. Bent knees, both empty hands together at mid-chest, knuckles aligned as if gripping a vertical hilt.
Frame2 top-middle: windup. Both hands together lift near right shoulder/temple, elbows bent; torso slightly coils.
Frame3 top-right: strike start. Both empty hands rise just above forehead, elbows flare slightly; stable planted legs.
Frame4 bottom-left: decisive downstroke. Both hands together move diagonally downward across upper torso, weight shifts toward front foot, hair and sash lag gently.
Frame5 bottom-middle: follow-through. Both hands together finish low beside opposite hip, torso leans modestly forward, knees grounded. No extra hand or blade.
Frame6 bottom-right: recovery. Hands return together to mid-chest guard, torso unwinds, matching frame1 silhouette closely for clean loop/transition.
The hilt/weapon is invisible in every frame: draw only the SAME Samurai body and anatomically coherent hands. No open palmed spell gestures or punching poses. Maintain color and costume, correct elbows, single head, two arms and two legs.
